title: Glass Blanks for the Glasswright
summary: Letty Lantern wants 3 glass blanks from the lamp pier taken to Wystan Sheaf before the Academy's visitor arrives, and then a word.
offer_text: "We need glass blanks, and what is stacked at the lamp pier is the town's to take. Carry it to Wystan Sheaf before the Academy's visitor arrives, then come and tell me."
turn_in_text: "Good. That is one thing in Duskwater that goes right."

objectives.text: Take 3 glass blanks from the pile
Hand the glass blanks to Wystan Sheaf
Tell Letty Lantern it is done

relationship.label: Ran an errand for the town
